QuestInfo.name: Perion's Specialty 1
QuestInfo.0: #bClaudine the Turncoat#k says that there's #bsomething that must be done#k before the #rBlack Mage statue#K is completed.
QuestInfo.1: She's convinced that Perion will become #ba great tourist destination#k, once the #rBlack Mage Statue#k is finished. That's why she wants to make souvenirs. Bring her some #t4033750##k items from #rPillaging Fire Boars#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought 25 #b#t4033750##k items for #bClaudine the Turncoat#k.

0.0: Have we met...? No matter. If you can walk, I can use you. I'm turning this place into a tourist attraction. The Black Mage statue will be its crowning jewel. But we have #rone little problem#k...
0.1: We don't have any decent souvenirs. I thought there'd be SOMETHING useful here, but the great and powerful Black Mage had to smite this town for resisting. Those foolish warriors.
0.2: Regardless, plenty of sentimental fools still remember old Perion. I believe a good stock of #b#t4033750##k, from the #rPillaging Fire Boars#k, would sell well to those stupid tourists. We can have the laborers carve faces into them or something. They'll sell like crazy.

yes.0: I'll need 25 #b#t4033750#s#k to turn a profit.

no.0: You're not interested? I can always just put the laborers on it, I suppose.

yes.0: I'll put the tribeswomen to work decorating these fangs. But only one type of souvenir seems a little pathetic...

item.0: You still haven't collected the 25 #b#t4033750##k items? The #rPillaging Fire Boars#k have them, remember?
